select t1.s_char2||''||1 from SR13782_empty_string_ydbrd_26167_unknown_table3_2 t1 left outer join SR13782_empty_string_ydbrd_26167_unknown_table3_1 t2 on t1.s_char2!='';（已确认，这个是||的规格，mysql null||字符串是null，不在这个需求中考虑）

1.2：case when查询结果与mysql不一致（已确认，这个是||的规格，mysql null||字符串是null，不在这个需求中考虑）

drop table t1;    
  create table t1 (c1 varbinary(100));    
  insert into t1 values('');    
  insert into t1 values(null);    
  insert into t1 values(null);    
  insert into t1 values(null);    
  commit;    
  select case c1||'' when c1||'' then 1 else 2 end from t1;

1.3：cross join查询结果与mysql不一致

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e4f8970c2af4f52183c/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..CLDiSVL_MrUMX8CAI2ET8b_7AqER1NDbT7a0461JXwM)

select t1.s_raw, t2.c_raw||'' from SR13782_empty_string_ydbrd_26167_unknown_table3_2 t1 cross join (select c_raw, c_raw||''||'' from SR13782_empty_string_ydbrd_26167_unknown_table3_1 where c_raw||''>'') t2 where t1.s_raw||'' = t2.c_raw or t1.s_raw||''>=t2.c_raw||'';
